# String To Byte Array

![String To Byte Array function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/conversion/05-string-to-byte-array.svg)

[Numeric functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

## Studio authoring profile

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.

<details>
<summary>Retained binding and help description</summary>

This is the source declaration, not the current measured product-execution assessment.

Converts raw String bytes to an exact rank-one U8 Array; preserves NUL and byte order without Unicode decoding.

Scalar String + optional encoding -&gt; 1D U8 array (and error in NXG). Studio: Studio value-only alias does not expose NI encoding/error terminals.

</details>
